observations.destination: Earliest region reached in the contiguous sequence of backward presses, conditional on readback.
observations.first_visit: Explicit one-region forward or backward/restart action, excluding terminal and jump-to-question.
observations.initial_risk: The trial has no preceding backward movement at this anchor.
observations.interpretation: Action endpoints. Comprehension was rated only after the full trial.
observations.words: A single-word region has exactly one whitespace-delimited orthographic word.

split.method: First 8 families by SHA-256 in each construction, both versions held together.
